edges.reason: Constructor assigns the router to the immutable uniswapV2Router.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for WETH and swap call.
addLiquidity reads uniswapV2Router for the addLiquidityETH call.
_transfer reads uniswapV2Pair for limit and swap checks.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads uniswapV2Pair balance.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads uniswapV2Pair balance.
_transfer reads and writes the swapping guard flag.
swapBack sends remaining ETH to marketingWallet.
swapBack sends ETH to devWallet.
_transfer enforces maxTransactionAmount on buys and sells.
_transfer compares contract balance to swapTokensAtAmount.
swapBack caps contractBalance using swapTokensAtAmount.
_transfer enforces maxWallet on recipients.
_transfer checks lpBurnEnabled before auto burn.
_transfer branches on lastLpBurnTime plus lpBurnFrequency timing.
limitsInEffect gates the limit enforcement block.
tradingActive gates transfers for non-exempt accounts.
swapEnabled gates the swapBack trigger.
transferDelayEnabled gates the per-block anti-bot check.
_transfer writes and reads the origin-keyed transfer delay mapping.
_transfer uses sellTotalFees to compute sell fees.
_transfer uses buyTotalFees to compute buy fees.
swapBack uses tokensForLiquidity to size the liquidity portion.
swapBack uses tokensForMarketing to size the marketing ETH share.
swapBack uses tokensForDev to size the dev ETH share.
_transfer checks fee exclusion mapping for from and to.
_transfer branches on automatedMarketMakerPairs for buy/sell logic.
_transfer checks max transaction exclusion mapping.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens uses percentForLPBurn to size the burn.
_transfer compares from and to against owner().
Constructor mints the total supply to msg.sender.
_msgSender originating from msg.sender flows into transfer logic.
onlyOwner uses _msgSender to authorize excludeFromFees.
startTrading sets lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp.
_transfer compares block.timestamp with lastLpBurnTime plus frequency.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as router deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as router deadline.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens records lastLpBurnTime as block.timestamp.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens uses block.timestamp for cooldown checks.
_transfer keys the anti-bot delay mapping by tx.origin.
swapBack performs a low-level ETH call to devWallet before final distribution.
swapBack sends the whole remaining balance to marketingWallet via low-level call.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap with no minimum output.
addLiquidity invokes addLiquidityETH with zero slippage minimums.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() on an external contract.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() on an external contract.
swapTokensForEth approves the router to spend contract tokens.
addLiquidity approves the router to spend contract tokens.
Constructor mints the initial supply exactly once.
_transfer calls swapBack when swap conditions are met.
_transfer calls autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens when burn conditions are met.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth for the ETH conversion.
swapBack calls addLiquidity when liquidity tokens exist.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private setter.
Constructor calls excludeFromFees for owner, self and dead address.
Constructor calls excludeFromMaxTransaction for router, pair and owner.
newAmount is validated then stored into swapTokensAtAmount.
newNum is scaled and stored into maxTransactionAmount.
updAds indexes the max transaction exclusion mapping.
isEx is written into the exclusion mapping.
account is written into the fee exclusion mapping.
excluded flag is written into the fee exclusion mapping.
pair is checked and forwarded to the private AMM setter.
value is forwarded to the private AMM setter.
newMarketingWallet replaces the marketing wallet state variable.
newWallet replaces the dev wallet state variable.
from drives limit checks, fee checks and super._transfer.
to drives limit checks, fee checks and super._transfer.
amount drives limit checks and fee computation.
tokenAmount is approved and swapped for ETH.
tokenAmount is approved and used for liquidity.
ethAmount is forwarded as value to addLiquidityETH.
_frequencyInSeconds is validated and stored into lpBurnFrequency.
_percent is validated and stored into percentForLPBurn.
_Enabled is stored into lpBurnEnabled.
percent is bounded and used to compute amountToBurn.
contractTokenBalance is read from balanceOf inside swapBack.
canSwap gates the swapBack invocation in _transfer.
takeFee gates fee collection in _transfer.
fees computed are transferred to the contract and subtracted from amount.
contractBalance is capped and split inside swapBack.
totalTokensToSwap is the denominator for proportional ETH splits.
liquidityTokens are passed to addLiquidity.
amountToSwapForETH is passed to swapTokensForEth.
ethForLiquidity is passed to addLiquidity and SwapAndLiquify event.
liquidityPairBalance is used to compute the automatic burn amount.
amountToBurn is transferred from the pair to the dead address.
amountToBurn is transferred from the pair to the dead address on manual burn.
path array is passed to the router swap call.
